The '''Quicktrigger Countermand''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] favored by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. They were easily modifiable and therefore became a popular item on the open market.

A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] once came into possession of one of these pistols by killing [[Cyrans]] the Unfeeling in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]].
